description: Get the options chain for a symbol. Provide an expiration timestamp to get a specific expiry, or omit for the nearest expiration.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous response's `pageInfo.endCursor` (applied to both calls and puts); omitted = first page

expiration.description: Expiration date as Unix timestamp in seconds (optional; defaults to nearest expiration)

fields.description: Comma-separated list of GraphQL field names to include; omitted = curated default set

limit.description: Maximum contracts per side (calls/puts) per page; omitted = curated default (25)

name: get_options
title: Options Chain
